title: Endorsement Manual: Owner Auto Policy Mid-Term Change Terms
content:
**Owner Auto Policy — mid-term change terms (identical on all six Cardinal Point liability packages).**

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| Effective date of a named driver exclusion | The later of the date the form was signed and the requested effective date |
| Return premium when a rated driver is excluded mid-term | Pro rata of the driver's full-term premium share |
| Reporting window, additional vehicle | 14 calendar days after acquisition |
| Reporting window, replacement vehicle | 30 calendar days after acquisition |
| Additional or return premium for a mid-term driver, vehicle or limits change | Pro rata from the change effective date |

**Vehicle reporting windows.**
- An additional vehicle (one that is not a replacement) reported within 14 days of acquisition receives coverage from its acquisition date.
- A replacement vehicle reported within 30 days of acquisition receives coverage from its acquisition date.

**Exclusion effective date.** The schedule gives this as the later of the form-signed date and the requested date. For the exclusion of the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, the exclusion takes effect on the date the company sets for that endorsement, never earlier than the signing date. This applies when that resident was reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted and carries no driver-added entry on the term. The exclusion of any other driver still takes effect on the later of the date the form was signed and the requested effective date on the form, never earlier than the signing date.

**Exclusion return premium.** The schedule gives this as pro rata of the driver's term premium share.
- **The reported resident described above** is first listed as a rated driver and then excluded, in one endorsement, and is charged a listing premium for the days between.
- **Any other driver,** including a resident once rated on the term by a driver-added entry:
  - a driver who was rated immediately before the exclusion has premium returned;
  - a driver who was unlisted has no premium change;
  - no listing premium is charged.

**Mid-term change premium basis.** The schedule gives this as pro rata from the change effective date. Three kinds of listing carry their own premium and their own effective date:
- the listing that precedes the exclusion of the reported resident described above;
- the re-listing of the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when that resident was rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and is not the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form;
- the lift of the exclusion of the driver on the term's latest claim report recording a named excluded driver.

Every other driver added is still charged the driver's full-term premium share multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by the term's days. Every other driver is still added effective the date the change is requested, never earlier.

**Hypothetical window check.** A replacement vehicle acquired on the 2nd and reported on the 31st is within its 30-day window. An additional vehicle acquired on the 2nd and reported on the 17th is outside its 14-day window.
